objective: Establish comparable UK technology coverage and one literal-source provider baseline; preserve gaps rather than manufacture intelligence.
jurisdictions: UK reference market; exact legal applicability not inferred

taxonomy.label: Software & applications
taxonomy.boundary: Products/platforms are not legal enterprises; catalogue supplier may be a reseller.

taxonomy.label: Cloud, infrastructure & connectivity
taxonomy.boundary: Hosting/provider role is distinct from software ownership or named-customer deployment.

taxonomy.label: Data & AI
taxonomy.boundary: A cross-cutting capability tag; AI catalogue membership is not an implementation.

taxonomy.label: Cybersecurity & resilience
taxonomy.boundary: Service/capability taxonomy, not evidence of customer vulnerability.

taxonomy.label: Consulting, integration, outsourcing & managed services
taxonomy.boundary: Primary operating-model segment; managed services can cross technology categories.

taxonomy.label: Channels, distribution & partnerships
taxonomy.boundary: Ecosystem role tag; alliance/accreditation is not a contract or implementation.

taxonomy.label: Emerging technology
taxonomy.boundary: Cross-cutting research tag; unresearched coverage remains a gap.

publication_limitations: Bounded first-page catalogue discovery, not exhaustive coverage or a market ranking.
Only literal publisher-reported catalogue facts are accepted for research publication, not canonical Enterprise Model state.
UK catalogue relevance is not proof of headquarters, significant operations, scale, customer adoption or buying demand.
All sources belong to one publisher family; independent acquisition is not independent source corroboration.
No model semantic verification performed. Unresolved interpretations/scenarios and programme coverage requirements are withheld or gaps.
Private workspaces, contacts and production stores are excluded; no automatic Pipeline creation/qualification.
